dataset.split_method: Graph-based isolated pair component splitting (no video ID leakage)

preprocessing.cache: Pre-extracted JPEG frames to disk to prevent CPU bottleneck

conclusion: The cached large experiment proved successful. A significant CPU decoding bottleneck was resolved by caching OpenCV DNN face crops into JPEGs (~12.5K images/hour prep rate). Training 4,200 videos (21,000 frames) completed rapidly per epoch (~4.5 minutes), reaching optimal validation state at Epoch 2. Tested effectively with an AUC of 0.9832.
